resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref (gate.ahram.org.eg/News//1893384.aspx) confirmed 404/unreachable with no Wayback snapshot available (CDX lookup returned no archived_snapshots for this exact URL). Neither wiki seed citation (egyptoil-gas El Molla inspection piece, the youm7 2021 roundup, the same ahram URL) states a capacity figure for this line -- checked all three. The petroleum.gov.eg Ministry PDF cited for Length/Cost is a national aggregate summary (total km / total EGP across many lines) and states no per-line capacity either. No verifiable source found for 8,000,000 tn/y; genuinely unresolved, not asserted as a dead-link replacement.

current_ref (petroleum.gov.eg PDF) is in fact live (re-fetched, saved, and text-extracted successfully) but it turns out to be a national aggregate summary with no per-line length figure, so it does not itself support 115.00 km -- superseded by two independent sources that do: (1) Youm7, 2021-12-19, states 'خط السخنة – التبين لنقل المنتجات البترولية بطول 115 كم' (Sokhna-Tebbin products pipeline, 115 km); (2) EGPC's own official 'Operation Projects (In Progress)' page (egpc.com.eg, live, government source) lists 'Sokhna/ Tebbin PL 24"/115 km' under a PPC crude/fuel-oil pipeline upgrade item. Both independently state 115 km exactly.

current_ref (gate.ahram.org.eg) confirmed dead, no Wayback snapshot. EGPC's official 'Operation Projects (In Progress)' page lists 'Sokhna/ Tebbin PL 24"/115 km' -- matches Diameter=24in exactly, alongside the matching 115 km length. Only one source found stating diameter; kept medium/non-independent.

current_ref (petroleum.gov.eg PDF) is live but is an aggregate summary with no per-line cost -- does not support 920,000,000 EGP directly. Youm7, 2021-12-19, states 'خط السخنة – التبين ... وبتكلفة 920 مليون جنيه' (Sokhna-Tebbin line ... cost 920 million EGP) -- exact match. A conflicting figure exists in Egypt Oil & Gas's feature article ('El-Sukhna/El Tebbin pipeline for mazut and diesel was completed in 2019 with costs of EGP 902 million') -- a different number, so per rule 7 it is NOT cited as support and is recorded here as a disagreement rather than used to raise the tier; kept medium/single-source on Youm7 alone.
